Concept sheet drawn from the spec note's parts table (tools/blocky/sheet.py); blocky style rules: Blocky-Style.md
Parts (the note's table; mirror x makes an R and an L)
Face plate: `crescent` (Rare eye), 28 x 14 px at 16 a stud, 5 frames
Silhouettes at 64 px (black shape, each view in its own frame)
Element: Iceberg. VFX: a soft light (Rare, Effects.luau): a cold mist rolls off the back of the
berg at 3 a second and sinks to pool at its feet (the Emitter at Back), a soft blue light over
the shell pulses every 4.5 s (the Light at Top) and a white sparkle glints on the peak every 4
s (the Sparkle at Top); it breathes 2 percent, very slowly; in the rig the lit summit pennant
waves, the front flippers paddle and the stub tail wags, and every 12 s it does a slow, proud
pirouette: a small hop and a full turn, the pennant swished and the flippers out
